literal: Smiling with the face, befriending is not friendship; of the heart, smiling with the heart, befriending is friendship.
translation: A friendship that merely smiles with the face is not true friendship; true friendship is that which smiles from the depths of the heart.
modern: முகம் மட்டும் மலரும்படி நட்புச் செய்வது உண்மையான நட்பு அன்று; உள்ளம் மகிழ்ந்து மலரும்படி நட்புச் செய்வதே உண்மையான நட்பாகும்.
explanation: This couplet distinguishes between superficial friendship and genuine affection. The poet contrasts the outward appearance of the face with the inner reality of the heart. A smile that is only on the face when meeting someone does not constitute real friendship. True friendship is established only when the heart itself rejoices and smiles with sincere love.
